arStrings.szText:
Increases your {c_important}Enchantment{/c} Potency by {c_number}[{SF_0} * 100|+%|]{/c}. 
Each equipped {c_important}Enchantment{/c} grants {c_number}[{SF_1} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage with their main element, and {c_number}[{SF_2} * 100|x%|]{/c} increased damage for the second {c_important}Enchantment{/c} if it is a different element.
